subject: [PATCH v2 4/5] btrfs: handle ENOMEM from btrfs_insert_dir_item() without aborting

2026-08-04.patch_summary: This patch modifies the Btrfs kernel code to handle ENOMEM errors from btrfs_insert_dir_item() without aborting the transaction. Instead of aborting, it clears the nlink count and orphans the newly-created inode when memory is exhausted during file system operations such as create(), mkdir(), mknod(), symlink(), and link(). This change allows for more graceful handling of memory pressure situations, preventing potential filesystem corruption.
